text_en: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.
text_cn: 那时，比拉多命人把耶稣带去鞭打了。

text_en: And the soldiers wove a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and they dressed him in a purple robe.
text_cn: 然后兵士们用荆棘编了个茨冠，放在他头上，给他披上一件紫红袍，

text_en: They kept coming up to him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews! ” and striking him on the face.
text_cn: 来到他跟前说：“犹太人的君王，万岁！”并给他耳光。

text_en: Pilate went out again and said to them, “Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no case against him. ”
text_cn: 比拉多又出去到外面，向他们说：“看，我给你们领出他来，为叫你们知道我在他身上查不出什么罪状。”

text_en: So Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said to them, “Here is the man! ”
text_cn: 于是耶稣带着茨冠，披着紫红袍出来了；比拉多就对他们说：“看，这个人！”

text_en: When the chief priests and the police saw him, they shouted, “Crucify him! Crucify him! ” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him; I find no case against him. ”
text_cn: 司祭长和差役们一看见耶稣，就喊说：“钉在十字架上！钉他在十字架上！”比拉多对他们说：“你们把他带去，钉在十字架上罢！我在他身上查不出什么罪状。”

text_en: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and according to that law he ought to die because he has claimed to be the Son of God. ”
text_cn: 犹太人答复他说：“我们有法律，按法律他应该死，因为他自充为天主子。”

text_en: Now when Pilate heard this, he was more afraid than ever.
text_cn: 比拉多听了这话，越发害怕，

text_en: He entered his headquarters again and asked Jesus, “Where are you from? ” But Jesus gave him no answer.
text_cn: 遂又进了总督府，对耶稣说：“你到底是哪里的？”耶稣却没有回答他。

text_en: Pilate therefore said to him, “Do you refuse to speak to me? Do you not know that I have power to release you, and power to crucify you? ”
text_cn: 于是比拉多对他说：“你对我也不说话吗？你不知道我有权柄释放你，也有权柄钉你在十字架上吗？”

text_en: Jesus answered him, “You would have no power over me unless it had been given you from above; therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin. ”
text_cn: 耶稣答说：“若不是由上赐给你，你对我什么权柄也没有；为此，把我交付给你的人，负罪更大。”

text_en: From then on Pilate tried to release him, but the Jews cried out, “If you release this man, you are no friend of the emperor. Everyone who claims to be a king sets himself against the emperor. ”
text_cn: 从此，比拉多设法要释放耶稣，犹太人却喊说：“你如果释放这人，你就不是凯撒的朋友，因为凡自充为王的，就是背叛凯撒。”

text_en: When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus outside and sat on the judge’s bench at a place called The Stone Pavement, or in Hebrew Gabbatha.
text_cn: 比拉多一听这话，就把耶稣领出来，到了一个名叫“石铺地”──希伯来话叫“加巴达”的地方，坐在审判座位上。

text_en: Now it was the day of Preparation for the Passover; and it was about noon. He said to the Jews, “Here is your King! ”
text_cn: 时值逾越节的预备日，约莫第六时辰，比拉多对犹太人说：“看，你们的君王！”

text_en: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him! ” Pilate asked them, “Shall I crucify your King? ” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but the emperor. ”
text_cn: 他们就喊叫说：“除掉，除掉，钉他在十字架上！”比拉多对他们说：“要我把你们的君王钉在十字架上吗？”司祭长答说：“除了凯撒，我们没有君王。”

text_en: Then he handed him over to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus;
text_cn: 于是比拉多把耶稣交给他们去钉死。 他们就把耶稣带去了。

text_en: and carrying the cross by himself, he went out to what is called The Place of the Skull, which in Hebrew is called Golgotha.
text_cn: 耶稣自己背着十字架出来，到了一个名叫“髑(dú)髅(lóu)”的地方，希伯来话叫“哥耳哥达”，

text_en: There they crucified him, and with him two others, one on either side, with Jesus between them.
text_cn: 他们就在那里把他钉在十字架上，同他一起另有两个人：一个在这边，一个在那边，耶稣在中间。

text_en: Pilate also had an inscription written and put on the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews. ”
text_cn: 比拉多写了个牌子，放在十字架上端，写的是：“纳匝肋人耶稣，犹太人的君王。”

text_en: Many of the Jews read this inscription, because the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
text_cn: 这牌子有许多犹太人念了，因为耶稣被钉在十字架上的地方离城很近，字是用希伯来、罗马和希腊文写的。

text_en: Then the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews, ’ but, ‘This man said, I am King of the Jews. ’”
text_cn: 于是犹太人的司祭长就对比拉多说：“不要写犹太人的君王，该写他自己说：我是犹太人的君王。”

text_en: Pilate answered, “What I have written I have written. ”
text_cn: 比拉多答复说：“我写了，就写了。”

text_en: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took his clothes and divided them into four parts, one for each soldier. They also took his tunic; now the tunic was seamless, woven in one piece from the top.
text_cn: 兵士将耶稣钉在十字架上后，拿了他的衣服，分成四分，每人一分；又拿了长衣，因那长衣是无缝的，由上到下浑然织成，

text_en: So they said to one another, “Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it to see who will get it. ” This was to fulfill what the scripture says, “They divided my clothes among themselves, and for my clothing they cast lots. ”
text_cn: 所以他们彼此说：“我们不要把它撕开，我们掷骰，看是谁的。”这就应验了经上的话：‘他们瓜分了我的衣服，为我的长衣，他们拈（niān）阄（jiū）。’士兵果然这样作了。

text_en: And that is what the soldiers did. Meanwhile, standing near the cross of Jesus were his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
text_cn: 在耶稣的十字架傍，站着他的母亲和他母亲的姊妹，还有克罗帕的妻子玛利亚和玛利亚玛达肋纳。

text_en: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing beside her, he said to his mother, “Woman, here is your son. ”
text_cn: 耶稣看见母亲，又看见他所爱的门徒站在旁边，就对母亲说：“女人，看，你的儿子！”

text_en: Then he said to the disciple, “Here is your mother. ” And from that hour the disciple took her into his own home.
text_cn: 然后，又对那门徒说：“看，你的母亲！”就从那时起，那门徒把她接到自己家里。

text_en: After this, when Jesus knew that all was now finished, he said (in order to fulfill the scripture), “I am thirsty. ”
text_cn: 此后，耶稣因知道一切事都完成了，为应验经上的话，遂说：‘我渴。’

text_en: A jar full of sour wine was standing there. So they put a sponge full of the wine on a branch of hyssop and held it to his mouth.
text_cn: 有一个盛满了醋的器皿放在那里，有人便将海绵浸满了醋，绑在长枪上，送到他的口边。

text_en: When Jesus had received the wine, he said, “It is finished. ” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
text_cn: 耶稣一尝了那醋，便说：“完成了。”就低下头，交付了灵魂。

text_en: Since it was the day of Preparation, the Jews did not want the bodies left on the cross during the sabbath, especially because that sabbath was a day of great solemnity. So they asked Pilate to have the legs of the crucified men broken and the bodies removed.
text_cn: 犹太人因那日子是预备日，免得安息日内──那安息日原是个大节日──尸首留在十字架上，就来请求比拉多打断他们的腿，把他们拿去。

text_en: Then the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who had been crucified with him.
text_cn: 兵士遂前来，把第一个人的，并与耶稣同钉在十字架上的第二个人的腿打断了。

text_en: But when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
text_cn: 可是，及至来到耶稣跟前，看见他已经死了，就没有打断他的腿；

text_en: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once blood and water came out.
text_cn: 但是，有一个兵士用枪刺透了他的肋膀，立时流出了血和水。

text_en: (He who saw this has testified so that you also may believe. His testimony is true, and he knows that he tells the truth. )
text_cn: 那看见这事的人就作证，而他的见证是真实的；并且“那位”知道他所说的是真实的，为叫你们也相信。

text_en: These things occurred so that the scripture might be fulfilled, “None of his bones shall be broken. ”
text_cn: 这些事发生，正应验了经上的话说：“不可将他的骨头打断。”

text_en: And again another passage of scripture says, “They will look on the one whom they have pierced. ”
text_cn: 经上另有一句说：“他们要瞻望他们所刺透的。”

text_en: After these things, Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus, though a secret one because of his fear of the Jews, asked Pilate to let him take away the body of Jesus. Pilate gave him permission; so he came and removed his body.
text_cn: 这些事以后，阿黎玛特雅人若瑟──他因怕犹太人，暗中作了耶稣的门徒──来求比拉多，为领取耶稣的遗体；比拉多允许了。于是他来把耶稣的遗体领去了。

text_en: Nicodemus, who had at first come to Jesus by night, also came, bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, weighing about a hundred pounds.
text_cn: 那以前夜间来见耶稣的尼苛德摩也来了，带着没药及沉香调和的香料，约有一百斤。

text_en: They took the body of Jesus and wrapped it with the spices in linen cloths, according to the burial custom of the Jews.
text_cn: 他们取下了耶稣的遗体，照犹太人埋葬的习俗，用殓布和香料把他裹好。

text_en: Now there was a garden in the place where he was crucified, and in the garden there was a new tomb in which no one had ever been laid.
text_cn: 在耶稣被钉在十字架上的地方，有一个园子，在那园子里有一座新坟墓，里面还没有安葬过人。

text_en: And so, because it was the Jewish day of Preparation, and the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
text_cn: 只因是犹太人的预备日，坟墓又近，就在那里安葬了耶稣。
